screenplay.text:
FINAL WHISTLE

                                     Written by

                                 The Panelwise team






























               Self-written sample screenplay for Panelwise.
               Licence: Apache-2.0, the same as the repository.













               FADE IN:

               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - DAY

               A sand pitch with bent goalposts and no nets. A crowd lines
               the touchlines on car bonnets and plastic chairs.

               The scoreboard is a blackboard: LIONESSES 1 - EAGLES 1.

               A girls' team in faded green kit, the LIONESSES, stands in a
               huddle. Their captain, PALESA (15), wears the armband over a
               bandaged wrist.

               COACH DLAMINI (40s), tracksuit, whistle, bucket hat, kneels
               in the middle of the huddle.

                                     COACH DLAMINI
                         Five minutes. They are tired. You
                         are tired. The difference is you
                         want it more.

                                     PALESA
                         And if they want it more too?

                                     COACH DLAMINI
                         Then run faster than your wanting.

               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - MOMENTS LATER

               The match. Dust kicks up. The Eagles' STRIKER, in red,
               breaks through and shoots.

               The Lionesses' goalkeeper, LINDI (14), small, with oversized
               gloves, dives. The ball smacks into her chest. She holds on.

                                     CROWD
                         Lindi! Lindi! Lindi!

               Lindi rolls the ball out to Palesa.

               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - CONTINUOUS

               Palesa dribbles up the left wing. A red defender slides in.
               Palesa hops over the tackle, but lands on her bad wrist.

               She cries out. The ball rolls away.

               The REFEREE (50s), striped shirt, blows his whistle.

                                     REFEREE
                         Free kick! Green!

                                                            SMASH CUT TO:









                                                                       2.


               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - TOUCHLINE - CONTINUOUS

               Coach Dlamini wraps fresh tape around Palesa's wrist. Palesa
               grits her teeth.

                                     COACH DLAMINI
                         You can come off. Nobody will say
                         anything.

                                     PALESA
                         I will say something.

                                     COACH DLAMINI
                         Then who takes the kick?

               Palesa looks across the pitch. Lindi stands alone in her
               goalmouth, bouncing on her toes.

                                     PALESA
                         Lindi.

                                     COACH DLAMINI
                         The goalkeeper?

                                     PALESA
                         She kicks it further than anyone.
                         She just never gets to.

                                                            CUT TO:

               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - CONTINUOUS

               Lindi jogs the whole length of the pitch in her big gloves.
               The crowd murmurs. The Eagles' players laugh and point.

               She places the ball. She takes four steps back. She pulls
               off her gloves and hands them to Palesa.

               The Eagles build a wall. Their goalkeeper crouches.

               The whistle.

               Lindi runs, and strikes the ball with everything she has. It
               rises over the wall, dips, and crashes in off the crossbar.

                                     CROWD
                         GOAL!

               The Lionesses pile on top of Lindi. Palesa holds up the
               gloves, laughing.












                                                                       3.


               EXT. DUSTY SOCCER FIELD - SUNSET

               The crowd has gone. The blackboard now reads LIONESSES 2 -
               EAGLES 1.

               Lindi sits alone on the touchline wearing her gloves, a
               small dented TROPHY between her feet. Palesa sits down next
               to her.

                                     PALESA
                         Next season you're playing striker.

                                     LINDI
                         Who goes in goal?

                                     PALESA
                               (holding up her taped
                               wrist)
                         Me. I'm better with my feet than my
                         hands anyway.

               They laugh. The sun goes down behind the bent goalposts.

                                                            FADE OUT.
